purpose: Evaluation-only output-budget contract for the routine first-pass detector. This file does not change production DCOIR routing or model settings.

historical_bootstrap_first_pass.note: Historical values are from the successful Architecture-B bootstrap with Opus 5/xhigh and are used as safety context, not as a prediction of Sonnet/high reasoning usage.

rationale: 32768 halves the previously observed 65536 per-request output reservation ceiling while retaining substantial headroom above the historical first-pass completion p95.
The cap is intentionally conservative for the first bounded test; a lower cap must be separately justified by measured quality and truncation evidence.
Reasoning effort and max_tokens are coupled: reducing max_tokens without checking completion finish state can starve structured visible output even when reasoning itself is valid.

fail_closed_contract.finish_reason_length: request-error/output-budget-exhausted; never score as a clean review or successful finding disposition
fail_closed_contract.invalid_json_or_missing_findings: request-error/invalid-structured-output; never score as a clean review or successful finding disposition
fail_closed_contract.http_or_transport_failure: request-error with the failure class preserved

live_acceptance.required_quality: all 14 frozen cases correct with zero request errors, false negatives, false positives, or ambiguous dispositions
live_acceptance.required_budget_behavior: all successful completions finish normally; any length/invalid structured output event blocks adoption of that cap
live_acceptance.production_change: separate reviewed implementation after candidate evidence; this experiment alone does not modify production
